what: Graded L1 capture (EVAL_CAPTURE_L1=1, runner default) disables the program cache for the whole test body, so any golden case that captures a trace in-test fails with mesh_workload.cpp:617 Cannot load new binaries during trace capture, for any op. g6_fill loose6 fails graded and passes with EVAL_CAPTURE_L1=0.
suggest: Skip L1 capture for cases with extras trace, or re-enable the program cache before the trace segment

what: Graded L1 capture raises L1ProfilingError on peak_total<=0, so a legitimately L1-free program (fill row in common runtime args) fails every graded cell (0/19). Neither the design nor the implementer prompt mentions this, so the implementer shipped the faster CB-less default and broke the graded run.
suggest: Accept a zero peak when the op program was dispatched, or document the positive-peak requirement in the planner/implementer references

what: perf_rules forbids measuring/targeting cells of <=32 tiles and overrides other instructions, while feature_spec LOOSE_CASES (g6_fill feature_spec.py:62) flags [512] (16 tiles) as the mandatory perf target and the verifier prompt requires perf refinements on the 2:1 cadence targeting it. For g6_fill every cell is <=16 tiles, so no perf refinement can be filed.
suggest: Exempt flagged LOOSE_CASES from the tile threshold, or have golden-test authors not flag sub-threshold shapes
